description: Create a Pinterest AUDIENCE to retarget or suppress. audienceType: VISITOR (people who fired your Pinterest tag — conversionTagIds, optional event, retentionDays 1–540), ENGAGEMENT (people who engaged with your Pins — engagementDomains REQUIRED, your claimed domain; optional engagementType click/save/closeup/comment/like), ACTALIKE (people similar to seedAudienceIds — country US, CA or GB, percentage 1–10) or CUSTOMER_LIST (customerListId, OR pass emails / maids and the list is uploaded — hashed on our server — and the audience made in one call). Every range Pinterest documents is checked before anything is sent. READ BACK from Pinterest; a new audience starts INITIALIZING. Spends nothing, 0 credits.

adAccountId.description: Pinterest ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

audienceType.description: audience kind; decides which other fields are required (see tool description)

conversionTagIds.description: VISITOR: the tag(s) whose visitors to collect

customerListId.description: CUSTOMER_LIST: id of an existing customer list to target

emails.description: CUSTOMER_LIST: upload these as a new list (hashed here) and make the audience in one call

engagementDomains.description: ENGAGEMENT: REQUIRED — your claimed website domain

engagementType.description: click, save, closeup, comment or like; omit to include all engagements

event.description: VISITOR: pagevisit, signup, checkout, viewcategory, search, addtocart, watchvideo, lead, custom (or a partner-defined tag event)

eventSources.description: web, mobile and/or offline: where the audience's events come from

ingestionSources.description: tag, mmp, file_upload and/or conversions_api: how events reach Pinterest

maids.description: CUSTOMER_LIST: mobile ad ids to upload as a new list, hashed on our server

pinIds.description: ENGAGEMENT: only people who engaged with these Pins

rule.description: raw Pinterest rule fields, merged last — expert use

seedAudienceIds.description: ACTALIKE: the audience(s) to find people similar to

name: create_pinterest_ads_audience
title: Create a Pinterest audience
